description: This file defines an Account class that manages user login, logout, save, refresh, and session handling for a trading platform, including deprecated warnings and integration with hub services.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Manages user account operations such as login, logout, save, refresh, and session management, with deprecation warning and hub service integration.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, creates hub service, pulls user data, and optionally saves session.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves user settings either via hub service or directly to file.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes user settings from hub service or local file.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out user from hub service and clears session.
